name: 댓글몽
description:
Cmong MCP collects reviews, shop status and sales from Korean delivery platforms for franchise head offices, and this connector makes that data available to Claude.

Ask questions across every store in your brand instead of opening a dashboard:

- What did customers complain about at our Gangnam store last month?
- Which stores had the sharpest drop in ratings this quarter?
- How did weekly sales move across platforms since August?
- Which stores are failing to reply to reviews?
- Who receives critical review alerts for each store, and is it switched on?

Five read-only tools are available: list_brands, get_review_stats, search_reviews, list_shops and get_sales. Review text comes through unmodified so you can read what customers actually wrote; counts, reply rates and rating distributions come from daily aggregates.

Access is scoped to the brands your organization has contracted. The connector never writes, and it cannot post replies, change settings or send messages.

Requirements: a Cmong BIZ account that manages a franchise organization, and an active data-integration agreement for that organization. Accounts without the agreement can sign in but see no data.

Notes on the data: all timestamps are Korea Standard Time (KST) with a +09:00 offset. Sales and review aggregates are daily snapshots refreshed once a day, so the current day is not included. Review search returns live data and may therefore disagree slightly with the aggregate figures.

_published_faq.name: How do I add 댓글몽 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add 댓글몽 to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.lemong.ai/partner/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the 댓글몽 MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: 댓글몽 provides these MCP tools: get_review_stats, get_sales, list_brands, list_shops, and search_reviews.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to 댓글몽?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to 댓글몽 in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
댓글몽 requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
댓글몽 is developed by Lemong Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
